decided: When the steward judges a change has drifted from its stage, the sensor fires whether or not the AI's own account admitted the drift; the reading marks which, so a setting can choose to stop the run only for drift the account did not admit.
alternatives: let drift the account admitted pass without firing
why: The account is written by the run after the work and approved by no one, so letting an admission excuse drift would let a run excuse anything by confessing it.

defines.definition: A check orbit runs over the code, the change and its history that reports whether a run has gone off course.
An independent reviewer, never the session that did the work, asked one question about a finished change: is it still the stage of the architecture doc it says it belongs to?
The AI's own plain-language record, written when a change's building is finished, of what it built and where it left its stage's plan.
